title: Romantic Getaway to Kolkata: A Couple's Guide for 2026
metaDescription: Plan the perfect romantic trip to Kolkata. Sunset spots, intimate dining, and unforgettable experiences for couples in love.
excerpt: Kolkata sets the stage for romance like nowhere else. From sunset views to intimate dinners, this guide will help you plan the perfect couple's getaway.
author: Trypinn Team
content:
Few places in the world can match the allure of Kolkata. Whether you are planning a romantic getaway to Kolkata for the first time or returning for more, there is always something new to discover. The landscapes shift, the seasons change, and the culture continues to evolve — yet the essence of Kolkata remains irresistibly captivating. Let this guide be your companion as you uncover the experiences that make this destination one of a kind.

## Most Romantic Spots

- Sunset viewpoints that offer breathtaking panoramas over Kolkata — bring a blanket and a bottle of wine
- Secluded beaches and hidden coves perfect for private moments away from the crowds
- Candlelit restaurants serving the finest local cuisine in intimate, softly lit settings
- Scenic walks through charming neighborhoods and historic streets hand in hand

![Romantic Kolkata](https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1558431382-27e303142255?fm=webp&w=1200&q=60)

## Romantic Activities

Cooking classes for two let you learn the secrets of India's cuisine while bonding over delicious food. You will laugh, learn, and eat well — the perfect date.

## Where to Stay

Luxury resorts with private pools and ocean views create the ultimate romantic atmosphere in Kolkata. Splurge on a suite with a balcony for breakfast with a view.

## Planning the Perfect Evening

Start with pre-dinner drinks at a rooftop bar overlooking Kolkata, then move to a reservation at a restaurant known for both its food and its atmosphere.
